name: A Risen Heart
source:
Tired? Lonely? Desperate? Welcome to A Risen Heart, a world of romance, drag queens, and queers! Prepare to flirt with hot guys and a hotter girl to discover the many intricacies of dating.

A Risen Heart is a dating simulator that allows players to court four characters from the Webtoon comic, "[url=https://www.webtoons.com/en/canvas/a-risen-heart/list?title_no=623381]A Risen Heart[/url]" by creator Byangelly.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2474320/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
疲劳的？孤独？绝望的？欢迎来到复活的心，这是一个充满浪漫、变装皇后和酷儿的世界！准备好与帅哥和辣妹调情，发现约会的许多复杂之处。

A Risen Heart是一款约会模拟器，允许玩家向创作者Byangelly创作的网络漫画“[url=https://www.webtoons.com/en/canvas/a-risen-heart/list?title_no=623381]A Risen Heart[/url]”中的四个角色求爱。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2474320/]Steam[/url]]
